stage1.image_operations: Preserve make_variants and fixed_rescale exactly; TF.rotate and PIL resize defaults are dependency-version-sensitive.
stage1.defense_generate_provenance: Actual installed lavis/models/blip_models/blip_caption.py generate defaults, collected from attackvlm environment.

features.embedding_normalization: Each caption embedding is L2-normalized; their mean is L2-normalized to obtain the center.

classifier.evaluation: 5 folds; sorted unique IDs shuffled with np.random.default_rng(20260729), np.array_split into 5 groups; pairs kept together.
classifier.default_export: five original OOF fold models per scenario only
classifier.deployment_export: explicit --include-deployment-model; separately labelled and not part of recorded OOF results

repair.name: bilateral_strong
repair.implementation: cv2.bilateralFilter(array, d=7, sigmaColor=50, sigmaSpace=7); borderType not explicitly passed in selected stage2 source.
repair.apply_to: standardized incoming image for Medium; not a rotated/rescaled detector variant

attack.parameter_provenance: 8/11 formal execution record; defaults in scripts are not the complete formal configuration.

threshold.meaning: evaluation only; distinct from risk threshold
